reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows that Nb slightly decreases room-temperature yield strength and that removing Ta reduces strength, but it does not directly test the HfMoNbTiZr alloy nor compare its density or properties to HfMoTaTiZr. The premises about density reduction and maintained strength/ductility are therefore largely unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Nb substitution reduces density relative to Ta
Nb maintains solid-solution strengthening in BCC HEA
Nb preserves high-temperature strength up to ~1000 °C
Nb does not degrade ductility at room temperature
HfMoNbTiZr will have comparable or better mechanical properties than HfMoTaTiZr
